## Ubue (CR 2)

**XP** 600  
CN Large humanoid (giant)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** low-light vision; Perception +8  


**Defense**


**AC** 18, touch 8, flat-footed 18 (+4 armor, -1 Dex, +6 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 30 (3d8+6)  
**Fort** +5, **Ref** +0, **Will** +1  
**Defensive Abilities** all-around vision; **Immune** flanking  
**Weaknesses** multiple personalities  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft. (30 ft. base)  
**Melee** 3 clubs +5 (1d8+3) or 3 slams +4 (1d6+3)  
**Ranged** 3 clubs +1 (1d6+3)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** superior multiweapon fighting  


**Tactics**


Ubues attack with savage brutality as if in an animalistic rage.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 16, **Dex** 9, **Con** 15, **Int** 8, **Wis** 10, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Weapon Focus (club), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Climb +7, Intimidate +5, Perception +8; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception  
**Languages** Giant  
**Gear** hide armor, 3 clubs  


**Special Abilities**


**Multiple Personalities (Ex)** The three heads of an ubue rarely get along with each other. Due to this division of personalities, there is a 15% chance in any given situation (usually once per encounter) that the heads get into an argument. An ubue engaged in an argument with itself takes a -2 circumstance penalty on attack rolls, Reflex saves, and to AC for the duration of the encounter, or until they can reach some sort of accord.
